svg.title: Equal magnitudes can conceal different inverse requirements
svg.desc: Synthetic mathematical illustration. See the caption and adjoining model for assumptions and interpretation.
svg.text: Equal magnitudes can conceal different inverse requirements
Fs = 16 MS/s; echo responses 1 − 0.8 exp(−jω) and 0.8 − exp(−jω)
Identical magnitude; phase is referred to the same input and output planes
Continuous phase (degrees; outside branch 180° at DC)
A magnitude sweep cannot establish all-pass phase, delay, or the correct inverse support.
An outside zero needs future data for an exact stable inverse; finite delay permits approximation.
Illustrative model • no measured receiver data
